items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know whether he knew about Scott Joplin.

ctx.x: I gather he favored ragtime, and Scott Joplin and things like that.
Yeah. Well, I don’t know whether he knew about Scott Joplin. But Fats Waller, I remember...
That’s right. He did like Fats Waller.
